privacy.title: Sutura shene
privacy.intro: Ajiya Ta ("iri", "iri-nga") go gaabandi ka sutura ni goy-coyey sutura-izey. Shene wo kayandi ka saawa da **Asariya N° 2017-28 hanki 3 Moolo 2017** kaŋ ga saba da boro-nga alhabarey gaabandi Niger Kwara ra da **CEDEAO Asariya N° A/SA.1/01/10**.
privacy.consent: Da ni goy da Ajiya Ta, ni yarda da alhabarey margayan da goy-yan mate kaŋ cina ne banda ra.
privacy.identification_list:
• Maa, maa-jina da maa-tugu
• Imel da/wala wayyo nambara
• Asusu baa-izey da nooru shenyey (XOF, USD, b.a)
privacy.financial_list:
• Goy-izey alhabar (duyan, fure, musanya)
• Hay-ka-fay, ndaare anniyey da fu-izey
• Biey / rasitidama (da ni no fondo)
privacy.technical_list:
• Jiin'a dumi da Android/iOS carma
• Porogaram dam-yan tantan-izey
privacy.storage_desc: Ka saawa da "Offline-First" cina-fondoo, ni nooru alhabarey kul ga tugu jiin'a wo ga-jina.
privacy.encryption: Da interneti hinkikoy goy ra, ni alhabarey ga tugandi ka saawa da asariya soolu-izey.
privacy.biometric_note: Ni kambe-kabe / moy-cee alhabarey ga goyandi ni wayyo nga-boro soolu-ra, iri si du ey abada.
privacy.rights_intro: Ka saawa da Niger da CEDEAO asariyey, ni gond'a alhakookey woey:
privacy.rights_list:
• **Hurutu alhaki:** Du kaagandi kaŋ ni alhabarey go goy ra.
• **Hanandi alhaki:** Ceeci ka barmay alhabarey kaŋ si saawa.
• **Kaa alhaki:** Ñaarandi ka kaa ni alhabarey hal abada.
• **Gangi alhaki:** Kaa ni gonda-yan alhabar goy-yan se sababu boori ra.
privacy.regulatory_desc: Da falgandi go no kaŋ mana ban iri do, ni gond'a alhaki ka koy **Haute Autorité de Protection des Données (HAPDP)** Niger kwara ra.
privacy.contact_desc: Hãyan kulu se shene wo ga:

terms.title: Goy-yan alhabarey
terms.object_text: Goy-yan Alhabarey woey (CGU) ga juwal hurutu da goy-yan porogaram wo ga **Ajiya Ta**.
terms.acceptance: Porogaram wo goy-yan ga kaagandi kaŋ goy-coy yarda da shene woey kul zaa sintin ga.
terms.service_nature_desc: Ajiya Ta ni nooru da hay-ka-fay juwal jinay-ize no. Porogaram wo ga naŋ ni ma nooru dirawey hani, ka ganay hay-ka-fayey da juwal asusuey.
terms.service_warning: Ajiya Ta manti garaw-fu wala banque nooru sanba-jinay no. Porogaram wo ni nooru cew-yan gaa-koy Jinay-ize no.
terms.obligations_list:
Goy-coy ga alhaki zaa ka :
• Dam alhabar boori-izey nga-boro boori ra.
• Si goy da porogaram wo ka boro hula wala ka kawa Niger da aduniyame asariyey ra.
• Sutura nga daabu-zeey (kod, kambe-kabe).
terms.liability_text: Ajiya Ta ga no cew-yaney da alhabarey bayandikay se. Iri si zanka zaa da goy-coy dam-fato go, alhabar-diga jiin'a hallagay ra, wala goy-kayandi zaari-ize ra.
terms.applicable_law: 5. Asariya Kaŋ Ga Goy da Tana-fay
terms.law_text: CGU woey go **Niger Kwara Asariya** ra.
terms.jurisdiction: Tana-fay kulu kaŋ mana ban alheri ra ga koy **Niamey Ciya-fuey** do.
